floater.name: wolf_plane_builder
floater.title: Plane Builder
floater.string: Close this window and open it again to try again.
Its picture could not be fetched - you can still build it.
The name can be at most %d letters.
Only letters, numbers, spaces and ' - . & please.
Squadron letters can be at most %d characters.
Squadron letters: A to Z, 0 to 9 and - only.
This aircraft comes in one livery only.

[TITLE] ([ERA]) Span [SPAN], length [LENGTH]. Armament: [GUNS]. It flies with the Wolf flight model, works with the flight deck's autopilot and autoland, fights in dogfight mode and carries a parachute.
You have [N] AI credits to spend - not enough for it.
You have [N] AI credits to spend. You pay only once it is in your inventory.
Wait a moment - this region is still being confirmed as Wolf Territories.
Sending your order to the yard...
[NAME] is waiting for the yard ([AHEAD] ahead of it). [PRICE] credits are held and charged only once it is delivered.
[NAME] is next in the hangar. [PRICE] credits are held and charged only once it is delivered.
[NAME] is in your inventory: Objects > [FOLDER]. [PRICE] credits were charged. Read the "How to fly" notecard in its folder, then take it up from Wolf Territories Home Airport.

[NAME] is in your inventory: Objects > [FOLDER]. Its [PRICE] credits will be taken from your balance shortly. Read the "How to fly" notecard in its folder, then take it up from Wolf Territories Home Airport.
Cancelled - you have not been charged.
The yard could not build it. You have not been charged.

panel.name: preview_panel
panel.tool_tip: Your plane as it will look. Drag to turn it.

combo_box.name: plane_type
combo_box.tool_tip: A real fighter, at its real size, with its real guns and flying figures

slider.label: Size (%)
slider.name: size
slider.tool_tip: Its size against the real aircraft's (90 to 110 %). It flies the same at any size.

combo_box.name: livery
combo_box.tool_tip: A period paint scheme of its type, or your own colours

color_swatch.label: Upper
color_swatch.name: upper_colour
color_swatch.tool_tip: Its upper surfaces and sides. Click to choose a colour.

color_swatch.label: Under
color_swatch.name: lower_colour
color_swatch.tool_tip: Its under surfaces. Click to choose a colour.

color_swatch.label: Spinner
color_swatch.name: spinner_colour
color_swatch.tool_tip: The propeller's spinner or nose ring. Click to choose a colour.

line_editor.name: letters
line_editor.tool_tip: Squadron code letters painted on the fuselage (up to 6: A to Z, 0 to 9 and -). Leave it empty for none.

line_editor.name: plane_name
line_editor.tool_tip: Painted under the cockpit and given to it in your inventory (up to 24 letters)

floater.text: Take it up from [secondlife:///app/teleport/Wolf%20Territories%20Home/1300/2953/24 Wolf Territories Home Airport] - fly it, and fight other planes in dogfight mode.

button.name: cancel_btn
button.label: Cancel the order
button.tool_tip: Take your order back while it is still waiting for the yard (nothing has been charged)

button.name: buy_btn
button.label: Buy credits...
button.tool_tip: Open the AI credits shop in your browser

button.name: build_btn
button.label: Build it
button.tool_tip: Send your design to the yard. It is built and put in your inventory; you pay only once it is there.
